system.description:
Power Push: Make an Interface Roll
against a target within Melee range. On
a success, they're knocked back to Far
range and take d10+2 techno damage
using your Proficiency.
Reactive Plating: Spend a Hope to
deploy reactive plates, smart-fiber
reinforcement, or a temporary armor
patch onto a target you can touch.
They gain a +1 bonus to their Armor
Score until their next rest or you run
Reactive Plating again.
Spike Printer: Make an Interface Roll
(12) to fabricate and launch a hardened
spike, anchor bolt, kinetic shard, or
compressed alloy projectile within Far
range. If you use it as a weapon, make
the Interface Roll against the target's
Difficulty instead. On a success, deal
d6 physical damage using your
Proficiency.
